name: merged-table-full-lifecycle
title: Complete merged table reservation, order and payment lifecycle
description: Create a composite table that can absorb one reservation or one/multiple active table order sessions, preserve source-table ownership, restore data on split, aggregate payment, and expose complete merge details to POS/table UI.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Implemented a transactional composite-table lifecycle: empty/reserved/occupied sources can merge; active reservations on more than one source are rejected; source order sessions remain distinct and are aggregated by composite queries/payment; reservations and source statuses restore on split; customer profiles stay on physical sources and are summarized in table/payment UI. Added focused backend/frontend tests, but they were not executed because the connected environment could not clone the repository and the repository has no attached GitHub Actions workflow for these commits.
